sections.summary: Renewable energy reporting often begins with policy background and definitions.
Historical electricity statistics show gradual change over two decades.
IEA, IRENA, and Ember use different but complementary measurement frames.
Ember reports renewables reached a record 30% of global electricity in 2023.
IEA forecasts solar PV and wind will account for 95% of renewable capacity additions through 2030.
IEA still identifies a gap between current trajectories and the tripling-renewables ambition.
Grid investment, permitting, and finance are the practical constraints to watch.
Appendix tables list detailed capacity and generation statistics.
